name: blog-theme
title: Blog theme
description: A thin blog theme for one collection: a paged post list and a post detail page (title, date, author, table of contents, body, previous and next post) with metadata, 404 and redirects (real 404 and 308 statuses come from a root proxy.ts, which Next 16 needs under cacheComponents). Pages are written to app/(site)/blog, plus a draft preview page at app/(site)/preview/blog (for site.previewPath = /preview).
